title: Show sales order delivery exceptions
description: Add a development-only read-only sales-order delivery-exception workspace over existing order/header or line delivery dates and ERP-032 approved stock-out progress. Use an explicit as-of date and preserve unknown evidence; do not rewrite order status or progress. Do not execute migration, production SQL, real database operations, irreversible data actions or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated bounded GET query filters sales orders by customer and as-of date and reports header or line delivery dates with ordered, approved-shipped and outstanding quantity evidence using stable paging.

Overdue, due-soon, fulfilled and unknown states reuse ERP-032 shipment progress; partial shipments remain open, line-specific dates take precedence, and missing dates or truncated evidence remain unknown.
The sales-order page opens a read-only delivery-exception workspace with customer/date filters and clear quantity and date evidence; related records are loaded in batches, not per order.

Focused unit tests cover delivery-date precedence, date boundaries, partial shipment, nonapproved stock-outs, unknown evidence and no-write semantics; the safe Release build passes and rules are documented.
